problem.name.message: Name the site, in 80 characters or fewer.
problem.name.note: Website tracking › Add site: the name field is empty or too long

problem.origin.message: Enter the site's address as https://shop.acme.io: https, a domain and, only when it isn't 443, a port.
problem.origin.note: Add site: the address isn't an https origin

problem.originLocal.message: Enter the site's address as https://shop.acme.io. While ReputeCast runs in development, http://localhost works too.
problem.originLocal.note: Add site in development mode: the address isn't https or a localhost address

problem.originOwn.message: {host} shows ReputeCast's own pages, which are never tracked: they stay cookie-less. Add your own site or store instead.
problem.originOwn.note: Add site: the address is the instance's or a workspace's custom domain; host: news.acme.io

problem.originTaken.message: {origin} is already a tracked site in this workspace.

problem.store.message: Pick a store connected to this workspace, or no store.
problem.store.note: Add site: the linked store isn't a connected store of the workspace

problem.siteGone.message: This tracked site doesn't exist or was deleted. Reload the list.
problem.siteGone.note: a site id that isn't the workspace's

snippet.wordpress.message: In WordPress, open Settings › ReputeCast, turn on Site tracking and paste this site id: {site}. To recognize signed-in customers, paste the identify secret there too.
snippet.wordpress.note: the WordPress tab of the site's snippet; site: the site's id

snippet.pixelConsent.message: This site waits for consent: events are sent once the visitor allows analytics.
snippet.pixelConsent.note: a comment in the Shopify custom pixel's code

snippet.pixelOpen.message: Shopify › Settings › Customer events › Add custom pixel, then paste this code.
snippet.pixelOpen.note: the first comment line of the Shopify custom pixel's code

activity.viewed.message: {count, plural, one {Viewed # product on {host}} other {Viewed # products on {host}}}
activity.viewed.note: a contact timeline line, one per day and site; host: shop.acme.io

activity.visited.note: a contact timeline line for a day with pages but no products; host: shop.acme.io

activity.carts.message: {count, plural, one {# added to the cart} other {# added to the cart}}
activity.carts.note: under the timeline line: how many products were added to the cart that day

hub.facts.message: {sites, plural, one {# site} other {# sites}} · {events, plural, one {# event today} other {# events today}}
hub.facts.note: the Website tracking card's fact line in Settings › Integrations

activity.source.note: the timeline line's source, after the date
